customer: Hello, I'm hoping to sell our cargo van now that the baby has arrived and we need something more family-friendly. The title lists both my husband and me as owners, but he may not be able to make the appointment because of his work schedule. Could you tell me what we'd need to do? We're in Texas, if that matters.
agent: Congratulations on the new baby! Per our article "When more than one person owns the car," every listed owner has to sign the sale documents, and the easiest way is for both of you to come to the appointment with your photo IDs. If your husband can't make it, he can sign power of attorney form NW-POA-2, which can be signed electronically with no notary needed. Also check how your names are joined on the title: if they're joined by 'or,' only one owner is needed, but if they're joined by 'and,' every owner is required.
